scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p api && tsc --noEmit -p web && tsc --noEmit -p desktop
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm test -w api && npm test -w web
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build -w desktop && playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
